name: std::messages<CharT>::~messages
intro: Destructs a std::messages facet. This destructor is protected and virtual (due to base class destructor being virtual). An object of type std::messages, like most facets, can only be destroyed when the last std::locale object that implements this facet goes out of scope or if a user-defined class is derived from std::messages and implements a public destructor.
